owner: Shared DayResolver / R17 Mass selection, not date-only Calendar UI

majorDate.rule: April 25 unless it coincides with Easter Sunday or Easter Monday, then Easter Tuesday

publicAction.rule: Only explicit local-public procession or Ordinary-authorized public supplications. Day Mass can follow public litanies even if II-class Rogation votive is impeded.

impediment.rule: First-class day impedes II-class Rogation votive; do not suppress Litanies or substitute its Proper.

rubrics.calendarOwner: The April 25 or transferred Easter Tuesday DayResolver selected proper always owns DAY_MASS; no St Mark/Easter octave/Sunday substitutions

sourceReuse.rule: Do not copy or re-prove common Latin/EN/FR sections. Compile a seasonal variant only after its own source gate succeeds.

required: Any extraordinary locally displaced rite outside the fixed Greater Litany must have its own calendar authorization and seasonal chants, rather than reusing this fixed-date publication.
Outside-Eastertide Minor Rogation transfer remains separately uncertified.

easterOctave.reason: Easter octave first-class day impedes II-class votive; preserve Easter day Mass and proper Easter octave Preface.

eastertideAfterOctave.reason: Actual Major Litany fixed date after Easter octave always uses existing certified two-verse Easter Alleluia and Paschal Preface in hoc potissimum; Sunday may require Creed.

easterTuesdayTransfer.reason: In Easter octave, I-class Easter Tuesday Mass follows the public Litany; no II-class votive.

availableNow.notes: For unimpeded after-Easter-octave Major Litany dates only (II-IV class) with explicit public rite, reused printed shared 1962 Exaudivit Proper and Easter Preface. On I class retain public Litany and day Mass.

validationNeeded: Phone EN/FR production-data checks must pass on a weekday after octave and a Sunday II-class after octave, including Creed on Sunday.
Easter octave transfer remains impeded and day Mass is preserved.
No arbitrary local transfer or outside-Eastertide variant is enabled.
Three published Minor-source certificates and the separate Major source gate must each remain independently effective.
Complete source-first 48-card LIVE and no duplicated Litany stages.

verifiedRelease.calendarProof: Gregorian Easter occurs March 22–April 25, so the fixed April 25 Greater Litany is always in Eastertide. If Easter Sunday or Monday collides, the Litany moves only to Easter Tuesday (Easter octave I class); the votive is impeded.
verifiedRelease.sourceMissal: Missale Romanum (1962), Vatican typical edition, pp.347–349, titled In Litaniis maioribus et minoribus
verifiedRelease.preface: Paschal Preface, in hoc potissimum; original Vatican 1962 pp.234–235; reused from published Eastertide Minor certificate
verifiedRelease.rubric346: The II-class Rogation votive is prescribed when a public procession or authorized public supplications are actually held; a I-class day impedes it
verifiedRelease.rubric343: Gloria is omitted in violet; Creed is ordinarily omitted except when prescribed by an occurring Sunday or octave. On an eligible II-class Sunday it is PRESENT.
verifiedRelease.originalEnglishFrench: Original internally reviewed EN/FR from existing published Minor Proper; not a new translation or independent imprimatur
